name: family-evidence-baseline-v1
rules: Catalogue presence is not transcription coverage.
Only definition-compatible measured dimensions may be compared.
Source lineage and rights survive derived exports.
acquisition_queue: Measure per-document context completeness: site, document class, source lineage, uncertainty and segmentation.
Export only dimensions with stable definitions for matched-degradation targets.
Preserve document-level clustering in all resampling.
